verses.text: After this, Yahweh's word came to Abram in a vision: "Don't be afraid, Abram. I'm your shield and your very great reward."
Abram said, "Lord Yahweh, what can you give me when I have no child? Eliezer of Damascus will inherit my household."
Abram continued, "You haven't given me any children, so someone born in my household will inherit everything."
Then Yahweh's word came to him: "This man will not be your heir. Your heir will come from your own body."
Yahweh brought Abram outside and said, "Look up at the sky and count the stars, if you can." Then he told him, "That's how many your descendants will be."
Abram trusted Yahweh, and Yahweh counted that trust as righteousness.
Yahweh said to Abram, "I am Yahweh, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees to give you this land as your inheritance."
Abram asked, "Lord Yahweh, how can I know I'll inherit it?"
Yahweh answered, "Bring me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."
Abram brought them all, cut the larger animals in half, and set each half across from the other. But he didn't cut up the birds.
Birds of prey swooped down on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.
As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep. A feeling of terror and deep darkness came over him.
Yahweh said to Abram, "Know for certain that your descendants will live as foreigners in a land that isn't theirs. They will be enslaved and mistreated for 400 years.
But I will judge the nation they serve, and afterward they will leave with great wealth.
You will die in peace and be buried at a good old age.
Your descendants will return here in the fourth generation, because the Amorites' wrongdoing has not yet reached its full measure."
When the sun had set and it was dark, a smoking firepot and a blazing torch passed between the animal pieces.
That day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram: "I have given this land to your descendants, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates:
the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, and Kadmonites,
Hittites, Perizzites, and Rephaim,
Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites."
